notes: The rest of the phone app, brought into line. Tickets and contracts are now the same cards as the asset list — a dot, two lines and a coloured pill — and every form behind them (asset, contract, person, ticket, monitor) is the same cards, the same soft fields and the same pill buttons. The side menu has a new set of icons and shows the install's own accent on the row you are on. Dark mode: fields were almost the same colour as the card they sat on, which made a form look empty; they are clearly a field now. Settings loses the home-screen shortcut offer. Contracts sort soonest-to-expire first and the filter pills carry their own counts.
